answer: Each AI agent registers on a decentralized ledger linking its ID to a cryptographic seed taken from the gale intensity recorded on a remote island at a precise moment. To answer a task, the agent first commits a hash, then reveals the answer together with a trellis‑generated nonce that can only be produced from that live seed. An attacker must hijack the island sensor and synthesize a matching trellis stream for every fake ID, raising the cost proportionally to the number of Sybil nodes.
